fields.mechanism: oxygen oxidation and conversion reaction (a chemical gas‑free lithium supply method originally developed for Si‑based LIBs).
fields.intervention: apply the same oxygen‑oxidation‑based prelithiation coating to the separator surface of the pouch cell, allowing lithium to be released to the anode during formation without electrolyte decomposition that produces gas.
fields.expected_effect: eliminates gas‑forming side reactions during early cycles, thus suppressing swelling while preserving cell energy density and cycle life.
fields.falsification_test: fabricate cells with the coated separator, run formation, and monitor cell thickness and internal pressure; successful suppression is indicated by <0.1 mm thickness increase versus >0.5 mm in control cells lacking the coating.

fields.mechanism: oxygen oxidation (as a chemical reaction that consumes oxygen and does not generate gas)
fields.intervention: incorporate a multiphase nanocomposite oxygen‑scavenging additive, analogous to the MNCP, into the pouch‑cell electrolyte or separator to actively oxidize residual oxygen during formation cycling, thereby preventing gas evolution
fields.expected_effect: suppression of gas‑induced swelling and blistering during formation without the need for a vent, while maintaining lithium‑ion transport and overall cell performance
fields.falsification_test: run parallel formation cycles on cells with and without the oxygen‑scavenging additive, monitor internal pressure rise and pouch thickness with a pressure sensor and laser profilometer; a statistically significant reduction in pressure and thickness change validates the mechanism

fields.mechanism: oxygen oxidation (as one of the two distinct mechanisms reported in the nanocomposite prelithiation agent)
Oxygen oxidation and conversion reaction occurring in the multiphase nanocomposite prelithiation agent, which consume residual oxygen and store lithium without producing gas.
fields.intervention: Coat the Si anode (or integrate within the electrode stack) with the multiphase nanocomposite prelithiation agent (MNCP) so that during formation cycling the oxygen oxidation and conversion reaction mechanisms operate to pre‑lithiate the anode and scavenge oxygen, eliminating gas evolution.
fields.expected_effect: Suppressed gas generation during formation, preventing pouch‑cell blistering and swelling while preserving or enhancing capacity and cycle life.
fields.falsification_test: Compare two otherwise identical pouch cells (one with MNCP coating, one without) under standard formation cycling; measure internal pressure rise and cell thickness change, and perform gas chromatography on any vented gases—absence of pressure increase in the MNCP cell falsifies the mechanism.
